TARGETED RECHECK OF EVOLVING OFF-TREE SHA-256 7f675eab082443777289095ddd37c0ec3556ed968e43018d6cdf628d09f100bd, 60,793 bytes.

PASS: the illustrative types now encode SourceOutcome and Partial(gaps, draft), matching the normative branches.

PASS: C17 now repeats the complete cross-root mutation set for Partial with a retained draft and proves removal of both reference and artifact remains a lawful non-validated Partial.

ONE SOURCE-STAGE CONTRADICTION REMAINS. The new text says V1 has no failure boundary after successful strict decoding but before constructed StorySource. The actual provider contract has exactly that boundary at core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/core/atlas.scala:111-120, unchanged at the StoryAtlas pin 3cf704a, published 7385cf9, and current main: StorySource.fromText rejects rawText.trim.isEmpty before canonical construction. Strict UTF-8 bytes containing only spaces/newlines decode successfully, establishing a decoded raw-string identity and decode receipt, then StorySource construction returns InvalidFormat(empty text). The proposed Refused(original, failure) branch and C2 would erase that completed decoded identity.

Minimal repair: let the refused source outcome retain optional decoded identity/receipt as well as admitted original identity, with decoded implying original/intake and canonical remaining absent. C2 needs four discriminating cases: failure before intake -> none; strict decode failure -> original only; whitespace-only post-decode StorySource refusal -> original plus decoded but no canonical; constructed source -> all three. Placeholder bytes remain forbidden and only present artifact references close against the manifest. If a different source pipeline intentionally fuses decode and validation, it still must not claim the decoded identity never existed when the decoder produced it.

Disposition remains narrow AMEND on this exact digest. No public type-name adoption, implementation, candidate, dependency, or landing authority is implied.
